comments.body:
Mechanism confirmed, fix applied, RED -> GREEN and teeth both proven.

DETERMINISTIC-VS-INTERMITTENT: intermittent, load-sensitive. Under 36x CPU oversubscription
on an 18-core host, the unfixed test failed 8 of 30 consecutive runs (~27%), which closely
matches the ~2/9 per-ubuntu-cell rate observed in CI. Post-fix, the identical load harness
gave 0 of 30.

The 8 pre-fix failures showed the deadline race in three shapes, all one cause:
  - `assert 'worker_timeout' == 'worker_failure'`  ([overflow-worker_failure], the CI param)
  - `assert 'worker_timeout' == 'binary_replaced'` ([replace-binary_replaced])
  - `assert 'abstain' == 'match'` at line 344      (the trailing retry, [nonzero], [replace])
The `JSONDecodeError` seen in CI is the narrower sub-case where the SIGTERM lands inside the
child's non-atomic `capture.write_text`.

EMPTY-CAPTURE WINDOW, measured directly by sweeping `_run`'s deadline across the child's
capture-write moment (40 runs per deadline):
  deadline=0.03  missing=10  EMPTY=2   complete=28
  deadline=0.04  missing=0   EMPTY=3   complete=37
  deadline=0.05  missing=0   EMPTY=2   complete=38
  deadline=0.06+ missing=0   EMPTY=0   complete=40
An EMPTY (not missing) capture.json is exactly the `json.loads('')` precondition.

CHILD COST: median 39 ms, p95 42 ms, max 307 ms over 30 idle samples — a 0.2 s budget is only
~5x the median with a tail that already crosses it on a fast host.

CI-SIDE CORROBORATION: in failing job 101290521991 the coverage report lists
`src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py` line 301 — the `raise _Abstain("worker_failure")`
— as UNCOVERED for the whole job, so the overflow case never reached the stdout-size check.

SEEDED-DEFECT PROOF (teeth): with the fix in place, deleting the
`len(stdout) > MAX_STDOUT or len(stderr) > MAX_STDERR` guard at
src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py:300-301 makes [overflow-worker_failure] FAIL with
`AssertionError: assert 'config_inspect_schema_skew' == 'worker_failure'`; restoring the guard
returns all 4 params to green. The parametrization now genuinely exercises the branch it names.

PUSH-VS-PR: confirmed exactly. Run 33960153355 (pull_request) checked out `refs/pull/137/merge`
— `HEAD is now at 3ad6f66 Merge 00b0faa67956... into 59d504c2bdbb` — while sibling push run
33960151040 resolved the branch head `00b0faa67956` alone and passed. The branch predates
59d504c2bdbb, so the PR run was the first execution of this test against a tree containing it.
The dependabot bump is not implicated.

NOT the missing-binary story: this test points PATH at its own fake-binary directory
(`monkeypatch.setenv("PATH", str(bin_dir))`), so the audited terraform-config-inspect is
irrelevant to it, and its exception comes from the harness reading its own capture.json
(test file line 186), not from the corroborator parsing tool stdout. Separate defect from
widish-chemic-goitered.

Fix: scope the shortened DEADLINE_SECONDS to `mode == "hang"` (raised to 1.0 s), and make the
fixture child's capture write atomic (staging path + os.replace). No product change; no
assertion weakened.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

`tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py::test_faults_abstain_redact_cleanup_and_retry[overflow-worker_failure]`
fails intermittently on the merge-gating `pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)` cell with
`json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)`. Every Gerrit patchset
re-runs that cell, so each change in flight carries a coin-flip chance of a spurious
`Verified -1` — this is why it is priority 1 rather than 2.

Observed rate (post-landing ubuntu-cell exposures): 2 failures / 9. Failed on `ubuntu-latest,
py3.11` and `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` in GitHub Actions run `33960153355`; passed on the three
ubuntu cells of each of Verified runs `33960223401` and `33960280894`. At ~2/9 per cell and three
ubuntu cells per Verified run, roughly half of all Verified runs are exposed.

## Provenance

The test file arrived on `main` in commit `59d504c2bdbb` ("Add terraform-config-inspect
corroborator", Gerrit change 2672), merged 2026-09-05T10:09:42Z. `rebar search` finds no existing
ticket for the symptom. That change is another session's work; this ticket fixes forward and does
not amend it.

Run `33960153355` is a `pull_request` run on the dependabot branch `github-actions-e1c1b90f49`.
Its checkout log records `HEAD is now at 3ad6f66 Merge 00b0faa67956... into 59d504c2bdbb`, i.e.
`refs/pull/137/merge`, while the sibling `push` run `33960151040` on the same branch head resolved
`refs/heads/dependabot/...` at `00b0faa67956` and passed. The branch head predates
`59d504c2bdbb`, so the PR run was the first execution of this test against a tree containing it.
The dependabot bump is not implicated.

## Approach

Root cause: the test does `monkeypatch.setattr(tc, "DEADLINE_SECONDS", 0.2)` for all four fault
modes, but only `hang` needs a shortened deadline. `overflow`, `nonzero` and `replace` are
produced by a fixture child that must RUN TO COMPLETION, and that child is a full CPython process
(`#!{sys.executable}` shebang, `tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py:96-141`).
Measured on an idle 18-core host the child's wall time is 27-42 ms median but its tail reaches
307 ms (1 of 30 samples over 200 ms); on a 4-vCPU GitHub runner under
`-n 4 --dist worksteal --cov` that tail routinely crosses 200 ms.

When it does, `_run` at `src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py:296` raises
`TimeoutExpired`, and `_terminate` (`:298`, defined `:323-342`) SIGTERMs the child's process
group. The child's `capture.write_text(...)` at
`tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py:118-124` is non-atomic: `Path.write_text`
opens the file in `w` mode (truncating immediately) and flushes only at close, so a SIGTERM inside
that window leaves `capture.json` zero-byte. The helper `_corroborate` then uses bare
`capture.exists()` as its readiness predicate at
`tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py:186` and hands `''` to `json.loads`.

Corroborating evidence from the failing job's own coverage report: line `301` of
`src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py` — `raise _Abstain("worker_failure")` — is listed
UNCOVERED for that entire job. The `overflow` parameterization never reached the stdout-size
check; it timed out first.

The product behaved correctly (it hit its deadline and abstained `worker_timeout`). The defect is
entirely in the test harness's own timing budget, so no product code changes. Two changes, both
strictly strengthening and neither weakening an assertion:

1. Apply the shortened deadline only when `mode == "hang"` (that fixture sleeps 10 s on purpose),
   and raise it to 1.0 s — ~25x the measured median child cost. `overflow`, `nonzero` and
   `replace` keep the production `DEADLINE_SECONDS = 60.0`
   (`src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py:30`), so their children always run to
   completion and `[overflow-worker_failure]` genuinely exercises the size check at
   `src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py:300-301`, which the CI coverage report proves
   it currently does not reach.
2. Make the fixture child's capture write atomic — write to a sibling temp path, then
   `os.replace` onto `capture.json`. This closes the truncate-to-flush window for every mode and
   makes `capture.exists()` a sound readiness predicate by construction rather than by timing
   luck.

Scoping the deadline to the one mode that needs it fits this problem because the deadline is
purely a test-runtime affordance for the deliberate 10-second sleep; the other three faults are
content faults, not timing faults, and imposing a wall-clock budget on them was the bug.

## Scope

- `tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py` — scope the shortened `DEADLINE_SECONDS`
  override to `mode == "hang"` in `test_faults_abstain_redact_cleanup_and_retry`, and make
  `_fixture_binary`'s generated child write `capture.json` atomically.

## Testing

- RED, mechanism, reproduced on demand: drive `_run` at a sweep of deadlines that land inside the
  child's capture-write window and count zero-byte `capture.json` outcomes. Measured against the
  unfixed harness: deadline 0.03 s leaves 2/40 empty, 0.04 s leaves 3/40, 0.05 s leaves 2/40, and
  0.06 s and above leave 0/40. That empty file is the exact `JSONDecodeError` precondition.
- RED, teeth, seeded defect: with the fix applied, delete the `len(stdout) > MAX_STDOUT` guard at
  `src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py:300-301` and confirm
  `[overflow-worker_failure]` FAILS on `assert result.receipt["reason_detail"] == detail` — the
  4 MiB of `x` then reaches `_load_module_json` and abstains `config_inspect_schema_skew` instead
  of `worker_failure`. Restore the guard and confirm the test passes again.
- GREEN, load: run `pytest tests/unit/grounding/ -n 16 --dist worksteal --cov=src/rebar` 12 times
  consecutively (oversubscribed against an already-loaded 18-core host) with zero failures.
- Happy path: `pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py -q` reports 24 passed,
  1 skipped.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `test_faults_abstain_redact_cleanup_and_retry` overrides `DEADLINE_SECONDS` only when
      `mode == "hang"`; verified by reading the test body and by
      `pytest tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py -q` reporting 24 passed,
      1 skipped.
- [ ] `_fixture_binary`'s generated child writes `capture.json` via a temp path plus `os.replace`;
      verified by `grep -n "os.replace" tests/unit/grounding/test_terraform_corroborator.py`
      returning the generated-script line, and by that file's tests passing.
- [ ] Seeded-defect proof recorded as a ticket comment: removing the `len(stdout) > MAX_STDOUT`
      check at `src/rebar/grounding/terraform_corroborator.py:300` makes
      `[overflow-worker_failure]` fail with `reason_detail == 'config_inspect_schema_skew'`, and
      restoring it makes the test pass.
- [ ] 12 consecutive runs of `pytest tests/unit/grounding/ -n 16 --dist worksteal
      --cov=src/rebar` all pass, evidencing the load sensitivity is gone.
- [ ] `make verify` is green in the worktree before the change is pushed to Gerrit.

file_impact.reason: Scope the shortened DEADLINE_SECONDS override to the hang mode only, and make the fixture child's capture.json write atomic via os.replace.

compiled_state.title: Terraform corroborator fault test races its own 0.2s deadline and reads an empty capture
